description: This file defines a utility class 'NetworkUtilities' providing methods for server communication, including authentication, syncing contacts, and downloading avatar images within an Android application.

classes.name: NetworkUtilities
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for server interactions such as authentication, contact synchronization, and avatar downloading.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Configures and returns an Apache HttpClient with specified timeout settings.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs server authentication with username and password, returning an auth token.

methods.name: syncContacts
methods.description: Performs a two-way synchronization of contact data with the server, returning a list of contacts to update locally.

methods.name: downloadAvatar
methods.description: Downloads an avatar image from the provided URL and converts it to a JPEG byte array.
